info.name: NetBird REST Accounts EDR Peers API
Bypass compliance for a non-compliant peer

params.name: peer-id
params.description: The unique identifier of the peer

items.docs:
Allows an admin to bypass EDR compliance checks for a specific peer.
The peer will remain bypassed until the admin revokes it OR the device becomes
naturally compliant in the EDR system.

info.name: Revoke compliance bypass for a peer

params.name: peer-id
params.description: The unique identifier of the peer

items.docs: Removes the compliance bypass, subjecting the peer to normal EDR validation.
Returns all peers that have compliance bypassed by an admin.
